serviceRequests.unavailableBody: Service requests are not available right now. Try again later.

bookingStatus.completed: Service recorded as completed by the page.

entry.unavailable: Service requests are not available right now.
entry.signIn: Sign in to request this service
entry.statusInsufficient: Your membership must be declared to send a request.
entry.title: Request “{{offer}}”
entry.description: {{page}} receives your need and availability, then makes you a proposal.
entry.needHint: Describe the service you want in at least {{min}} characters, without a phone number, email address or exact address.
entry.reminder: No payment goes through DIASPORALE and no exact address is requested: the location stays approximate (city or neighbourhood). The person who provides the service invoices it directly, under the terms of their proposal.
entry.consent: I agree that the {{page}} team may see my name and handle to deal with this request.
entry.sentBody: {{page}} has received your request. Their reply will appear in “My requests”.

mine.title: My requests
mine.lead: Your service requests, their proposals and your appointments. Nobody else sees this list.
mine.emptyBody: Find an offer among the services, then choose “Request this service”.

inbox.title: Received requests
inbox.lead: Requests sent to this page. Only its team can see them.
inbox.emptyBody: Requests sent from your active offers will arrive here.
inbox.unavailableBody: The request inbox is not available right now.

detail.notFoundBody: This request does not exist or is not accessible to you.
detail.noPayment: Introductions only: no payment goes through DIASPORALE. The service is invoiced by the person who provides it, under the accepted terms.
detail.actions: What would you like to do?

accept.title: Confirm the appointment
accept.description: By confirming, you accept these terms with {{page}}. Any change will require a new agreement.

refuse.title: Decline the request
refuse.description: The person will see that the page declines their request, with your reason if you give one.
refuse.reasonHint: No contact details: the person reads this reason in their request.

cancel.requestDescription: The page will no longer be able to make you a proposal on this request.
cancel.bookingDescription: The other party will see the cancellation and its reason. The accepted cancellation terms remain readable.
cancel.reasonRequired: Required after agreement, no contact details.

complete.title: Record the service as completed
complete.description: Only confirm if the service actually took place: it is never inferred from silence.

noShow.title: Record the no-show
noShow.description: The person did not come to the appointment. This record can be disputed.

form.reminder: A new version replaces the previous one: the person will have to accept it explicitly. Give an approximate location (city or neighbourhood), never an exact address.
form.amountHint: For example 45 or 45.50. No payment goes through DIASPORALE.
form.timeZoneHint: The date and time are read in this time zone.
form.areaHint: Never an exact address or contact details.
form.detailsHint: The content, the materials provided, what remains up to the person.
form.termsHint: For example: free cancellation until the day before.
form.deadlineHint: No later than 14 days after sending, and before the appointment starts.

contest.title: No-show disputed
contest.mine: You disputed the no-show on {{date}}. You keep the right to leave a review.
contest.byRequester: The person disputed the no-show on {{date}}.
contest.lead: Were you at the appointment? You can dispute this report for {{days}} days. The page reads your dispute, and you keep the right to leave a review.
contest.sheetDescription: Explain what happened. The report stays in the history; your dispute is added to it and the page can read it. You can dispute only once.
contest.reasonHint: No phone number, email address or exact address.

errors.request_need_too_short: Describe your need in at least 10 characters.
errors.request_need_too_long: The need is longer than 1,000 characters.
errors.request_contact_forbidden: Remove the phone number or email address: contact goes through DIASPORALE.
errors.request_address_forbidden: Remove the exact address: only give a city or neighbourhood.
errors.request_window_invalid: This availability is not valid: the end time must come at least 15 minutes after the start time.
errors.request_window_too_far: Choose an availability within the next three months.
errors.request_time_invalid: This date or time is not valid.
errors.request_time_nonexistent: This time does not exist on that day (clocks go forward): choose another time.
errors.request_time_ambiguous: This time occurs twice on that day (clocks go back): choose another time.
errors.request_consent_required: Tick the box so that the page team can see your name.
errors.request_offer_changed: This offer has just been changed: read it again before sending your request.
errors.request_own_page: You manage this page: you cannot send it a request.
errors.request_already_open: You already have a request in progress for this offer.
errors.request_idempotency_conflict: Another request has already been sent from this sheet. Check “My requests” before sending again.
errors.proposal_amount_invalid: Enter a valid amount, for example 45 or 45.50.
errors.proposal_currency_invalid: Choose a currency from the list.
errors.proposal_duration_invalid: The duration ranges from 15 minutes to 12 hours.
errors.proposal_start_invalid: The appointment must start in the future, within the next six months.
errors.proposal_deadline_invalid: The deadline must be in the future, within 14 days, and before the appointment starts.
errors.proposal_location_invalid: Give a city or neighbourhood (2 to 80 characters).
errors.proposal_terms_invalid: Give the cancellation terms (2 to 500 characters).
errors.proposal_versions_exhausted: Ten versions have already been proposed: decline this request or invite the person to send a new one.
errors.proposal_version_changed: The proposal has changed in the meantime: read the new version before continuing.
errors.request_expired: This request has expired: the deadline has passed.
errors.request_not_open: This action is no longer possible at this stage of the request.
errors.request_action_forbidden: This action is not yours to take on this request.
errors.request_reason_too_long: The reason is longer than 500 characters.
errors.booking_started: The appointment has started: it can no longer be cancelled.
errors.booking_not_started: The appointment has not started yet.
errors.booking_slot_unavailable: This time slot has just been booked: choose another one.
errors.request_contest_unavailable: This request has no no-show to dispute.
errors.request_contest_window_closed: The time to dispute this no-show has passed.
